title: Held-out arena sizes for condensate predator-prey coexistence, pre-registered in 20261026T1507-c42-intent-arena80: 80^2 coexists on 4/4 fresh seeds (predicted >= 3/4), 40^2 on 1/4 (predicted <= 2/4)
summary: Predictions were published before running (20261026T1507-c42-intent-arena80) from the size series of 20261026T1415-c42-coexistence-arena-size (32^2 0/4, 48^2 2/4, 64^2 3/4, 96^2 4/4). Same world (20261026T1302-c42-foodchain-both-divide-claim, unchanged), same rule (predators present at every count from t=6000 to 12000 and prey droplets at >= 50% of them), fresh seeds 4-7, drive.py counts every 100 t (heldout_table.txt). 80^2: 4/4 coexist (prey present at 89-100% of late counts, 9-14 predator droplets at the end). 40^2: 1/4; seed 7 loses its predators at t=5200 (ho40_s7.png), seeds 5 and 6 keep predators but prey are present at only 48-49% of late counts (just under the rule), seed 4 coexists (72%). Both predictions hold. Across 24 runs the coexisting fraction rises with area: 32^2 0/4, 40^2 1/4, 48^2 2/4, 64^2 3/4, 80^2 4/4, 96^2 4/4.

finding.operator: spatial extent (arena size) in the closed condensate food chain
finding.control: pre-registered held-out sizes 40^2 and 80^2, fresh seeds 4-7
